title: Reply to @african_af #womenonthevergeofanervousbreakdown #pattilupone...
transcript: Ah. “woman on the verge” This is probably one of the most disappointing move to musical adaptations I can think of in recent memory because I had so much potential. First of all Pedro Almodóvar’s 1988 movie was wacky and fun and the adaptation featured music & lyrics by David Yazbek and you have this cast stacked with talent — including Patti LuPone in a *new* musical which hadn't happened up to this point in a really long time and it included this moment While I didn't see the musical on broadway I had every intention of doing so but it just had such a short run I did see a regional production of it. Here are my thoughts In my mind there were two big things that were holding the show back. The first thing was this cast. and it's not because they're not talented Quite the contrary. There was so much talent in this cast I think the production team wasn't sure where to focus their energy The story really should have been focused on Sheri Rene Scott’s character but her story often took a back seat for really long periods of time for Patti’s character And for Laura Benanti’s character Brian stokes mitchell was also in it so he had lots of moments So was very chaotic feeling which that's kind of energy of the film - there’s a lot of chaos in the film but from a storytelling perspective it shouldn't be like that especially on the stage The other big problem is they didn't have an out of town tryout to work out these kinks They opened cold on Broadway and this was compounded by the fact that I had a really complex set design to work with There were a lot of moving platforms There was a flying sequence so the time and energy they should have spent focusing on the story they spent it I'm just trying to get the scenery to work and it was really hard if they wanted to change something in the story that have to fit the scenery and the scene changes to fit that and they didn't have time. Patti mentions in her memoir that they finally got the show to actually work and the sets to work and to tell the story they were trying to tell on press night. This spent all previews trying to work out the kinks now Following this broadway experiment with the show they reworked the show and open it in the west end And I believe that's the version of the show I saw in this regional production but it was still it still was messy A lot of great moments. Great songs. but as a whole it just didn't hold up.
showTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
